name: Torrellas (Spain)
description: Blue field with a white chevron pointing to the fly and yellow stripes across the fly, charged at the hoist with three yellow towers.
history: Municipal flag of Torrellas; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: chevron issuing from the hoist corners and pointing to the fly
two horizontal stripes across the fly
